context.body: The bounded canonical source is Exodus 34:1–10; its local speaker, audience, sequence, and literary form remain controlling evidence.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Moses cuts new tablets, the LORD descends and proclaims mercy, grace, patience, covenant love, forgiveness, and judgment.
observations.label: Covenant renewal begins with the divine name: action

observations.body: Moses asks that the stiff-necked people be taken as an inheritance.
observations.label: Covenant renewal begins with the divine name: response

payload.posture: Read Exodus 34:1–10 as covenant at the mountain evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Mercy and accountability are proclaimed together, and Israel remains stiff-necked inside renewed covenant.
payload.title: Covenant renewal begins with the divine name
